Aspectual magic.title: Aspectual magic

Properties: Aspectual magic operates by using the unique properties of magicules to rewrite the laws of the world, causing them to be altered and achieve new properties, allowing the imagined phenomena to manifest into reality using the same set of laws as theWorld Language.[1][2]As an example, magicules imbued with the image of sapping heat will result creating an effect of ice.[3]By further building on the basic image with a magic formula, the user can add conditions such as shape, range, and velocity to achieve something like anIcicle Lance. In short, it is the ability to skip the natural process and skip straight to the results instantly.

With aspectual magic, the main component of the attack is always the magicules carrying the caster's embodied image and any visual phenomena such as fire or ice is merely an incidental tertiary component of the spell rather than the focus.[3][2]As a result of this, it is impossible to do things like extinguishing a magical flame with ordinary water.[4]For the same reason, aspectual magic is capable of effecting and damagingspiritual life-forms, beings of pure thought and energy.[3][2]
Casting: In order to perform aspectual magic, the user requires a strong mental image of the phenomena they wish to create and a certain level of understanding of the world's laws. To supplement this process, tools such as incantations, handseals, and other rituals are often utilized to help reinforce the image in the caster's mind. Once what they wish to happen is solidifed within their mind, the caster will then utilize theirspiritual powerto gather magicules either from their own internal stores or from the atmosphere around them using their internal source as a catalyst.[2]Once the spell is constructed and the magicules are gathered, the only step remaining is to activate the magic usingmana. At this point the magic will remain in effect indefinitely until its energy is expended, it runs out of mana, or the caster shuts it off.[4]

For example, fire magic combined with explosive magic results in the explosive flame magic used byEraldandShizu.

Due to the nature of compound magic its contents aren't compiled into an easily accessible magical formula. As a result of this, all of the aspects of the spell like launch speed, targeting accuracy, size and scope of the effect, and duration are in complete control of the casters whims. However, casting compound magic requires an intense amount of mental capacity that normal magicians are unable to handle and a large amount of mana to keep it under control. On the god's end, since there's no way to assist many people at once, they link together and borrow the cumulative computational power of their believers to share the burden of putting themagictogether. Through Marionette Heart it is possible to listen and communicate between the host of the magical gadget and the keeper of the real heart. The form of encrypted communication used in Marionette Heart runs on electric signals and natural geomagnetism similarly to Clayman'sunique skillManipulator, without the use of any magicules.
